# @fyit/crouton-bookings

> Bookings for locations with or without time slots, each offering team products with a stock, with optional email notifications. Perfect for courts, rooms, appointments, equipment rentals, and more.

AI hint: use when app involves appointments, reservations, or scheduling

## Components

- `CroutonBookingsBookingCard`: Individual booking display card
- `CroutonBookingsCalendar`: Calendar date picker for booking
- `CroutonBookingsDateBadge`: Date display badge
- `CroutonBookingsLayoutCalendar`: The bookings calendar as a placeable layout block
- `CroutonBookingsLayoutList`: The bookings list as a placeable layout block
- `CroutonBookingsList`: Bookings list with filters
- `CroutonBookingsLocationTabs`: One sideways-scrolling row of location tabs (optional "All", admin "+"; hidden with one location), shared by the panel and the booking form
- `CroutonBookingsPanel`: Main booking sidebar container
- `CroutonBookingsSlotIndicator`: Visual slot availability indicator

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useBookingAvailability`
- `useBookingCart`
- `useBookingEmail`
- `useBookingEmailVariables`
- `useBookingOptions`
- `useBookingSlots`
- `useBookingsList`
- `useBookingsSettings`
